controls.label: Toggle
controls.description: An on/off setting. Select it, then press Confirm or click its action.

controls.label: Radio group
controls.description: Choose one option. Click an option, or use Left / Right while this setting is selected.

controls.label: Slider
controls.description: Drag to adjust. The value is committed when you release the mouse. Left / Right changes one step.

controls.label: Number stepper
controls.description: A bounded numeric value with consistent steps.

controls.label: Option selector
controls.description: Cycle through named options. Their labels are shown instead of internal IDs.

controls.label: Text input
controls.description: Click the field and type, then select Save text. Text entry currently requires a keyboard.

controls.label: Run example
controls.description: Runs a five-second example. This button enters a busy state while the progress and loading examples update.

controls.label: Progress bar
controls.description: Read-only progress between zero and one. The kit displays a percentage.

controls.label: Loading state
controls.description: A pulsing indicator for work whose completion time is unknown.

controls.label: Confirmation dialog
controls.description: Preview a confirmation dialog. This example changes no game data.
controls.confirm: Run this example action? No game data will change.

controls.label: Disabled action
controls.description: Unavailable actions stay visible with an explanation. They cannot be activated.

controls.label: Information panel
controls.description: Extensions provide content. CSSX provides fonts, panels, navigation, input prompts and transitions.
